prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic playful overhead social-media portrait with a white halter bikini top, blue bedding and an expressive wink-and-smile.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with fair natural skin, subtle freckles and flushed cheeks, wavy light-brown to blonde hair spread around her head, one brown eye open and the other winking. She wears a white halter bikini top with black embroidered zig-zag trim, small gold hoops and a delicate gold chain with a small dark charm.
prompt.composition_elements: Use a 2:3 overhead bird's-eye view of the adult subject lying on her back, centered from head through upper torso. Keep her tongue out with a broad toothy smile, hair spread over the pillow and blue textured pillow and blanket filling the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural indoor light evenly illuminates the face, freckles, hair and white fabric with gentle realistic shadows. Keep the feeling cheerful, candid and friendly.
prompt.technical_specs: 2:3 vertical overhead smartphone framing, sharp focus on facial expression and trim, realistic hair strands and textile weave, natural skin detail, moderate contrast and clean candid color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic playful overhead social-media portrait of one original approved adult woman with fair natural skin, subtle freckles and flushed cheeks, wavy light-brown to blonde hair spread around her head, one brown eye open and the other winking. She wears a white halter bikini top with black embroidered zig-zag trim, small gold hoops and a delicate gold chain with a small dark charm. Use a 2:3 overhead bird's-eye view as she lies on her back, centered from head through upper torso, with her tongue out and a broad toothy smile. Let her hair spread over a light-blue textured pillow and blanket. Use soft natural indoor light, realistic hair and textile weave, natural skin detail, moderate contrast and clean candid color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, body-part emphasis, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, unreadable text or logos
